evidence_quotes: 106 earthquakes were recorded over the 21-day window, averaging roughly 5 events per day
with the busiest days falling on Feb 3 and Feb 14 (9 events each)
Magnitudes ranged from M4.0 to M6.1, with an average of M4.64
Tobelo, Indonesia led all regions with 12 events, including a notable M5.7 on Feb 14 at moderate depth (153 km)
shallow M5.2 off Honshu, Japan (2.7 km depth)
No tsunami warnings were triggered across any of the 106 events
criticisms: The report states the M5.7 Tobelo event was at 'moderate depth (153 km)' — the digest shows 152.9 km, so this is a minor rounding that is acceptable.
The report says 'averaging roughly 5 events per day' — 106 events over 21 days is approximately 5.05, so this is a reasonable approximation.
The report references 'shallow Solomon Islands activity' without specifying magnitude or depth, which is vague but not fabricated — the digest does show a Solomon Islands event at 13.6 km depth.

The M6.1 maximum magnitude is cited but no specific sample event in the digest shows a M6.1 event; it appears only in the summary statistics. The report does not claim a specific event at M6.1, only that the range peaks there, which is supported by the summary.
The report mentions 'several recorded at very shallow depths (under 10 km)' for Mohr, Iran — the digest shows events at 8.5 km and 1.9 km for Mohr, supporting this claim.
